name: VWAP
description: This is a price action keyword which will calculate the instantaneous VWAP of the instrument under consideration. VWAP needs to be used for an instrument which has volume data. As an example, VWAP for Nifty 50 spot does not exist as the same does not have volume. VWAP need not be used under position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This is a price action keyword which will calculate the instantaneous VWAP of the instrument under consideration. VWAP needs to be used for an instrument which has volume data. As an example, VWAP for Nifty 50 spot does not exist as the same does not have volume. VWAP need not be used under position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1631865084.png)

The keyword shared above will return the VWAP for the current tick of NIFTY futures.

![Example](./images/img-1632483799.png)

In the example share above, one can check the if the LTP of Nifty 50 futures is greater than the VWAP of the same

![Example](./images/img-1632484044.png)

In the example share above, one can check the if the LTP of Nifty 50 current week ATM CE is greater than the VWAP  of Nifty 50 current week ATM CE

The volume-weighted average price (VWAP) is a trading benchmark used by traders that gives the average price a security has traded at throughout the day, based on both volume and price.

Read about VWAP here -  https://www.investopedia.com/terms/v/vwap.asp
